svg.title: Seat map of show s1 at 18:04
svg.desc: Screen at the top. Row A is regular at Rs 200, row B premium at Rs 350. A1 and A2 are booked by alice, booking B1. A3 and A4 are held by bob, hold H3, until 18:11. Row B is all available.
svg.text: a held seat is shown taken until its expiry, then free
to everyone, whether or not anything cleaned it up
